payload.title: The migration-authoring runbook bans ADD COLUMN NOT NULL DEFAULT on populated tables as a full-row rewrite, which is false for constant defaults on the production PostgreSQL 16 and contradicts the migration-sql-lint gate, steering authors to a heavier three-step path
evidence: docs/runbooks/migration-authoring.md:178 (bans ADD COLUMN NOT NULL DEFAULT, claiming it rewrites every row in one transaction)
tools/gates/migration-sql-lint.ts:442-454 (rule R2 flags only NOT NULL without DEFAULT)
docker-compose.infra.yml:12 (CI and local infrastructure run the same pg16 image)
payload.rule_violated: Repo rule that a runbook states engine behaviour truthfully and agrees with the gate that enforces it (plan section 3, ADR 053 runbook amendment)
payload.notes: Program module-boundaries, package PKG-00, release R1.
